name: AutoBot
description: Lookahead bot with self-calibrating cube/robot/ship physics that learns from deaths.

horizon.name: Lookahead (frames at 60 fps)
horizon.description: How far ahead the planner simulates. 60 is about 1 s.

beam-width.name: Planner width
beam-width.description: Paths kept per frame. Higher is smarter but uses more CPU.

hazard-margin.name: Hazard safety margin (units)
hazard-margin.description: Spikes are treated as this much bigger. Raise it if the bot clips spikes.

learn-from-deaths.name: Learn from deaths
learn-from-deaths.description: After a crash, give the hazards near it extra room on the next attempt.

debug-draw.name: Draw debug overlay
debug-draw.description: Red = hazards, blue = blocks, yellow = orbs/pads, green line = the path the bot plans.

use-orbs.name: Click orbs
use-orbs.description: Let the planner click orbs when the player touches them.
